metadata.title: Micron surpassed two tech heavyweights in market cap today - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 min ago
Micron surpassed two tech heavyweights in market cap today
Micron's market capitalization of $1.41 trillion Thursday morning put it above Meta Platforms and Tesla in value, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
Micron has never finished a trading day ahead of Meta by market cap, and it was last larger than Tesla in October 2019, the data showed.
